query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('depth',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT kind,count(*) FROM jobs WHERE finished_at IS NULL GROUP BY kind) x),'jobs',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]') FROM (SELECT id,kind,attempts,max_attempts,locked_at,locked_by,finished_at,error,run_after FROM jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200) x)) AS "page!"
